name: pail-verify
description: Quint models of pail's publish protocol, store and branch policy, and the tools that check them

scripts.compile: npm run compile:publish && npm run compile:store && npm run compile:policy
scripts.check: npm run compile:publish -- --check && npm run compile:store -- --check && npm run compile:policy -- --check
scripts.test: quint test store_scenarios.qnt --main=storeScenarios --match='Run$' && quint test scenarios.qnt --main=scenarios --match='Run$' && quint test soft_scenarios.qnt --main=softScenarios --match='Run$' && quint test policy_scenarios.qnt --main=policyScenarios --match='Run$'
scripts.simulate: quint run pail.qnt --main=pail --invariant=safety --max-steps=100 --max-samples=20000 && quint run pail.qnt --main=pail --step=contendStep --invariant=safety --max-steps=60 --max-samples=20000
scripts.witness: for inv in gcNeverDeletesAPack gcNeverDeletesAChunk branchHasNoHugeFile; do quint run pail.qnt --main=pail --invariant=$inv --max-steps=100 --max-samples=200000 | grep -q '^\[violation\]' || { echo "never reached: $inv"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.compile:policy: quint-refinements compile policy_scenarios.qnt --module policyScenarios --compact --artifact policy/policy-refinements.json --rust ../tests/policy_refinement/generated.rs --go policy/pailpolicy_refinement_gen_test.go --go-package gateway
